packageRules.description: Keep the Playwright CI image (literal tag in .gitlab-ci.yml, job e2e) in sync with @playwright/test; deploy/ci/check-yaml.py fails the pipeline when they differ
docker:NN (CLI image) and docker:NN-dind (daemon) must move together
Major updates are never grouped and need a manual look
A new Python minor version (3.12 -> 3.13) is a deliberate decision: scipy/asyncpg wheels, backend/pyproject.toml, Dockerfile.backend and CI move together
Keep TypeScript within the range supported by typescript-eslint
Require manual review before a PostgreSQL major-version upgrade
